metadata.description: An alleged criminal syndicate based in Gauteng, South Africa, involved in drug trafficking, tender fraud, and contract killings.
Pretoria-based tenderpreneur and alleged leader of the Big Five cartel; owner of Cat VIP Protection Services.
Businessman and suspected underworld kingpin; accused of masterminding the murder of DJ Sumbody and others.
Prominent Amapiano DJ and entrepreneur; co-founder of Ayepyep lifestyle lounge, murdered in 2022.
President of ActionSA and former Mayor of Johannesburg; prominent entrepreneur and politician.
Former South African Police Minister; allegedly received cash payments from Cat Matlala.
Suspended Police Minister; linked to Cat Matlala through business associate Brown Mogotsi.
Judicial commission established in 2025 to investigate criminal capture and political interference in the justice system.
North West businessman and associate of Cat Matlala; alleged to have channeled cartel funds to ANC political events.
Late taxi boss described as the 'president' of the Big Five cartel.
Crime Intelligence head who provided key testimony exposing the Big Five cartel at the Madlanga Commission.
Deputy National Police Commissioner; allegedly received monthly payments from Cat Matlala to secure tenders.
KZN Hawks head; allegedly shared sensitive police information with Cat Matlala.
Actress and ex-girlfriend of Cat Matlala; target of an attempted murder linked to the cartel.
Gauteng health whistleblower murdered in 2021 after exposing irregular contracts linked to Matlala.
South Africa's ruling party, which allegedly received funding from the Big Five cartel.

edges.description: Identified as one of the primary leaders of the syndicate.
Identified as a central member and hitman for the cartel.
Former taxi boss who served as the cartel's president.
Accused of ordering the high-profile hit on DJ Sumbody in November 2022.
Business associates involved in tender coordination and political funding.
Close associate who allegedly protected cartel interests within the minister's circle.
Matlala allegedly paid Cele R500,000 in cash; Cele admitted to staying at Matlala's penthouse.
Allegedly paid millions to cover ANC event expenses via Brown Mogotsi.
Allegedly paid Sibiya R1 million monthly for tender protection.
Collaborated on disbanding the Political Killings Task Team (PKTT).
Orchestrated an attempted murder (hit) against his ex-girlfriend.
Deokaran exposed Matlala's irregular hospital contracts shortly before her assassination.
Established to probe the cartel's capture of the South African justice system.
Primary witness providing intelligence on the cartel's hierarchy and operations.
